summary: Both Expect lines hold at 004a6ad. The fix is correct: latestRelease now returns each version's commit (a branch's sha, or the tag's peeled ^{} sha, which wins over the tag object), and the release check passes only when the installed commit is a git ancestor-or-equal of that release commit (contains()). If it does not contain it, or git can't tell (null), the old version comparison still fails it. Mutation 1: forcing the contained condition to true in selfcheck.mjs turned two tests red (session-start 'rows: a failing release check is the only failure...' and the builder's new 'release: an install whose commit already contains the newest release passes...', whose second half checks an uncontained 9.9.9 still fails). Mutation 2: dropping the peeled-tag preference in fingerprint.mjs (using the tag object sha) did NOT turn any test red, so peeling is untested; the real origin has an annotated tag harness-v0.1.0 (tag 7abbe62, peeled 7d6b0b4) that would exercise it, but the newest release is a branch so it is not hit. Runs here at 004a6ad: clean room hooks, claude -p and release mode all pass; hooks/claude modes install version 0.1.0 against newest release 0.1.1 and pass (the exact case that went red), release mode installs harness-v0.1.1 (7 of 7). CI at 004a6ad: clean-room job (run 41095337207) success; the push run of release/harness-v0.1.1 at 196ea09 (run 41094831214) also success. Scratch proof unchanged. PROBLEM FOR THE MERGE (not for the Expect lines): ci 'test' job at 004a6ad is RED (148 of 150 pass). ci.yml's checkout is shallow, and two tests assume history: the builder's new session-start test (git rev-parse HEAD^ fails: unknown revision) and scripts/clean-room/test/run.test.mjs 'green' (self-check says 0.1.1 is out because the release commit is not in the shallow clone, so contains() is null and the check fails closed). Both pass locally with full history. Fix needed from the builder: fetch-depth 0 in ci.yml's test job, or make the tests self-contained. The gates job was red on the same sha (no verdict at that head yet). Doubts: (1) CI still uses hooks without a model; claude -p only ran locally. (2) A real install whose repo clone lacks the release commit fails closed; that is right but worth knowing. (3) Container npm test: 150 of 150 pass.
